text:
maya: Quick poll — packing sneakers in a carry-on for the offsite: what do you use to keep them from grossing out your clothes? :sneakers: :thinking:

tom: Shower cap + shoes inside. Cheap and weirdly effective. :ok_hand:

eli: +1 shower cap. Also put them in the bottom of a small packing cube so the dirt doesn’t touch shirts.

jen: I grab a hotel pillowcase when I can, or a thin plastic grocery bag if not. Tucks into the laundry spot.

sam: Shoe trees on a plane would be a flex. For real though, slip a dryer sheet inside each shoe. Smell gone. :dash:

maya: Pillowcase is smart — doubles as laundry bag on the return. Anyone tried that?

eli: Yup, worked last offsite. Pro tip: tuck laces inside so they don’t snag stuff.

tom: Also, wear the bulkiest shoes on the flight if you can. Saves space in the bag.

jen: Packing checklist I use for weekend offsites:
```
- shoes in shower-cap or pillowcase
- dryer sheet in shoes
- socks or small bag over soles
- pack cubes, shoes at bottom
- bandaids + travel lint roller
```

maya: vote time — react with :one: for shower cap, :two: for pillowcase, :three: for packing cube

travel-bot: Poll created: 1) Shower cap 2) Pillowcase 3) Packing cube — ends in 24 hours.

sam: clicked :two: — pillowcase is multipurpose.

eli: :three: from me if you want shape retention and compression.

tom: Also FYI if you’re traveling to EU: some hotels charge for laundry. check before assuming free.

jen: Friendly reminder: if you borrow an adapter from someone, leave a snack in exchange. travel etiquette. :cookie:

maya: I have one spare international adapter (UK/EU/US) if anyone needs it.

sam: I’ll take it! Can meet on Friday afternoon? :pray:

maya: DM sent, will drop off Friday.

eli: tiny debate: compression socks on long flights — necessary or theatrical?

jen: Necessary for long red-eyes or if you’re prone to swelling. otherwise optional.

tom: Comfy, but I only bring ankle compression. Saves me from swollen ankles on day 2.

maya: this escalated into full packing advice thread. thanks yall! I’ll post poll results later. :v:
